This script covers two revision items that reuse the Fig. 5 recovery pipeline:

- **Item 34** (R1#5, R3-minor#16): recovery of nested TE insertions vs. other TEs, and recovery as
  a function of the nested insertion rate (0% vs. the default random 0-30% vs. 30%).
- **Item 35** (R1#6): sensitivity of recovery to the beta-distribution parameters controlling TE
  integrity (default alpha = 0.5, beta = 0.7 vs. mostly fragmented 0.5/2 vs. mostly intact 2/0.5).

Section 1 uses the existing 20 Fig. 3D/5 genomes (4 scenarios x 5 replicates). Sections 2-3 use
the 12 runs from `14_tair10_sensitivity_nest_beta.sh`, which reuse scenario 1 replicates 1-3's TE
tables and seeds (paired design); the existing scenario 1 replicates 1-3 are the baseline.

In the simulator's GFF, a nested insertion carries `Nest_in=<host>`, and the host TE it lands in
is split into two pieces, each carrying `Cut_by=<insert>`. Both pieces keep the host's whole-element
`Integrity`, although each piece is only part of the host, so host pieces are reported separately
rather than mixed into the integrity bins of other TEs.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
WRK <- "/workspace/cflthc/script/TEgenomeSimulator_publication_code" # clean up this line before git push
SIMOUT <- file.path(WRK, "output")
OUT <- file.path(WRK, "output/sensitivity_nest_beta/")
dir.create(OUT, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = OUT)

reps_existing <- 1:5
reps_sweep <- 1:3
sweep_configs <- c("nest0", "nest30", "fragheavy", "intactheavy")
```

```{r, load_libraries, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)
```

## 1. Load per-locus recovery

```{r, load_helpers, echo=FALSE}
# One row per ground-truth locus: recovered (80% reciprocal overlap with a RepeatMasker hit),
# identity, integrity, and category (nested insert / host piece / other)
read_truth_recovery <- function(res_dir){
  eval_dir <- file.path(res_dir, "RM_recovery_eval")
  read_bed <- function(f, recovered){
    read.delim(file.path(eval_dir, f), header = FALSE, quote = "", comment.char = "",
               colClasses = c("character", "integer", "integer", "character")) |>
      dplyr::transmute(attr = V4, recovered = recovered)
  }
  dplyr::bind_rows(read_bed("truth_with_overlap.bed", TRUE), read_bed("truth_without_overlap.bed", FALSE)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(identity = as.numeric(sub(".*Identity=([0-9.]+).*", "\\1", attr)),
                  integrity = as.numeric(sub(".*Integrity=([0-9.]+).*", "\\1", attr)),
                  category = dplyr::case_when(grepl("Nest_in=", attr) ~ "nested insert",
                                              grepl("Cut_by=", attr) ~ "host piece",
                                              TRUE ~ "other"),
                  # same binning as te_sim_eval_bedtools.sh: 10 bins, 1.0 goes into the last bin
                  identity_bin = pmin(floor(identity * 10), 9),
                  integrity_bin = pmin(floor(integrity * 10), 9)) |>
    dplyr::select(-attr)
}

bin_label <- function(b) ifelse(b < 9, sprintf("[%.1f-%.1f)", b / 10, (b + 1) / 10), "[0.9-1.0]")
category_levels <- c("other", "host piece", "nested insert")
category_colors <- c("other" = "grey40", "host piece" = "#E69F00", "nested insert" = "#0072B2")
```

```{r, load_existing, echo=FALSE}
loci_existing <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(1:4, function(n){
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(reps_existing, function(i){
    read_truth_recovery(file.path(SIMOUT, sprintf("TEgenomeSimulator_tair10_sd_scenario%d_rep%d_result", n, i))) |>
      dplyr::mutate(scenario = paste0("scenario", n), rep = i)
  }))
})) |>
  dplyr::mutate(category = factor(category, levels = category_levels))
```

```{r, load_sweep, echo=FALSE}
sweep_dirs <- unlist(lapply(sweep_configs, function(cfg){
  file.path(SIMOUT, sprintf("TEgenomeSimulator_tair10_sens_%s_rep%d_result", cfg, reps_sweep))
}))
sweep_done <- all(file.exists(file.path(sweep_dirs, "RM_recovery_eval", "truth_with_overlap.bed")))

if (sweep_done) {
  loci_sweep <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    # baseline: the existing scenario 1 runs whose TE tables and seeds the sweep reuses
    loci_existing |> dplyr::filter(scenario == "scenario1", rep %in% reps_sweep) |>
      dplyr::select(-scenario) |> dplyr::mutate(config = "baseline"),
    dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(sweep_configs, function(cfg){
      dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(reps_sweep, function(i){
        read_truth_recovery(file.path(SIMOUT, sprintf("TEgenomeSimulator_tair10_sens_%s_rep%d_result", cfg, i))) |>
          dplyr::mutate(config = cfg, rep = i, category = factor(category, levels = category_levels))
      }))
    }))
  )
}
```

`r if (!sweep_done) "**Sweep outputs from 14_tair10_sensitivity_nest_beta.sh are not complete yet, so sections 3 and 4 are skipped.**"`

## 2. Item 34: nested vs. non-nested recovery in the existing genomes (no new simulation)

```{r, nested_existing_summary, echo=FALSE}
cat_existing <- loci_existing |>
  dplyr::group_by(scenario, rep, category) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), rate = mean(recovered), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::group_by(scenario, rep) |>
  dplyr::mutate(pct_loci = 100 * n / sum(n)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(scenario, category) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_mean = mean(n), pct_loci_mean = mean(pct_loci),
                   rate_mean = mean(rate), rate_sd = sd(rate), .groups = "drop")

kable(cat_existing, digits = c(0, 0, 0, 2, 3, 3),
      caption = "Recovery rate by locus category (mean +/- SD across 5 replicates per scenario).")
write.csv(cat_existing, paste0(OUT, "nested_category_recovery_existing.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

Saved file name: nested_category_recovery_existing.csv

Recovery by identity bin, per category (pooled rate within each replicate, mean +/- SD across
replicates). Identity is comparable across categories; integrity is not (host pieces carry the
whole host's integrity), so it is not used to stratify here.

```{r, nested_existing_plot, echo=FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.asp = 0.35}
plotwidth <- 10
plotheight <- 3.5
cat_identity <- loci_existing |>
  dplyr::group_by(scenario, rep, category, identity_bin) |>
  dplyr::summarise(rate = mean(recovered), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::group_by(scenario, category, identity_bin) |>
  dplyr::summarise(sd = sd(rate), rate = mean(rate), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(identity_mid = identity_bin / 10 + 0.05)

p_nested <- ggplot(cat_identity, aes(x = identity_mid, y = rate, colour = category)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 1.2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(rate - sd, 0), ymax = pmin(rate + sd, 1)), width = 0.02) +
  facet_wrap(~scenario, nrow = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = category_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black")) +
  labs(x = "Identity (bin midpoint)", y = "Recovery rate", colour = NULL)
p_nested
```

```{r, save_nested_existing_plot, echo=FALSE}
png(filename = paste0(OUT, "nested_category_recovery_by_identity.png"), width = plotwidth, height = plotheight, units = "in", res = 1200)
print(p_nested)
while (!is.null(dev.list()))  dev.off()
```

Saved file name: nested_category_recovery_by_identity.png

## 3. Item 34: nesting-rate sweep (scenario 1, replicates 1-3)

`nest` is the percentage of each LTR/Copia and LTR/Gypsy family's copies inserted as nested
insertions (total copy number is unchanged). In the A. thaliana library, Gypsy elements are
labelled LTR/Ty3, so only Copia families are nested here.

```{r, nest_sweep_summary, echo=FALSE, eval=sweep_done}
nest_levels <- c("nest0", "baseline", "nest30")
nest_loci <- loci_sweep |> dplyr::filter(config %in% nest_levels) |>
  dplyr::mutate(config = factor(config, levels = nest_levels))

nest_per_rep <- nest_loci |>
  dplyr::group_by(config, rep) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_loci = dplyr::n(),
                   pct_nested_insert = 100 * mean(category == "nested insert"),
                   pct_host_piece = 100 * mean(category == "host piece"),
                   rate = mean(recovered), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::group_by(rep) |>
  dplyr::mutate(diff_vs_baseline = rate - rate[config == "baseline"]) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

nest_summary <- nest_per_rep |>
  dplyr::group_by(config) |>
  dplyr::summarise(pct_nested_insert = mean(pct_nested_insert), pct_host_piece = mean(pct_host_piece),
                   rate_mean = mean(rate), rate_sd = sd(rate),
                   diff_vs_baseline_mean = mean(diff_vs_baseline), diff_vs_baseline_sd = sd(diff_vs_baseline),
                   .groups = "drop")
kable(nest_summary, digits = 4,
      caption = "Overall recovery by nesting setting (mean +/- SD of 3 paired replicates; difference to the baseline within each replicate).")

nest_by_category <- nest_loci |>
  dplyr::group_by(config, rep, category) |>
  dplyr::summarise(rate = mean(recovered), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::group_by(config, category) |>
  dplyr::summarise(rate_mean = mean(rate), rate_sd = sd(rate), .groups = "drop")
kable(nest_by_category, digits = 4, caption = "Recovery by locus category and nesting setting (mean +/- SD of 3 replicates).")

write.csv(nest_per_rep, paste0(OUT, "nest_sweep_per_replicate.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(nest_summary, paste0(OUT, "nest_sweep_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(nest_by_category, paste0(OUT, "nest_sweep_by_category.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

Saved file names: nest_sweep_per_replicate.csv, nest_sweep_summary.csv, nest_sweep_by_category.csv

## 4. Item 35: integrity (beta distribution) sweep (scenario 1, replicates 1-3)

Recovery depends on identity and integrity (Fig. 5), so changing alpha/beta should change overall
recovery mainly by changing how many copies fall into each integrity bin, especially below 0.1.
The re-weighting check below tests this: it predicts each config's overall recovery from the
baseline's per-bin (identity x integrity) recovery rates weighted by the config's own bin counts,
and compares the prediction with the observed rate. Host pieces are excluded from the
re-weighting because their integrity label is the whole host's.

```{r, beta_sweep_summary, echo=FALSE, eval=sweep_done}
beta_levels <- c("fragheavy", "baseline", "intactheavy")
beta_labels <- c(fragheavy = "beta(0.5, 2)", baseline = "beta(0.5, 0.7) default", intactheavy = "beta(2, 0.5)")
beta_loci <- loci_sweep |> dplyr::filter(config %in% beta_levels) |>
  dplyr::mutate(config = factor(config, levels = beta_levels))

# baseline per-bin rates, pooled over the 3 baseline replicates
baseline_bin_rates <- beta_loci |>
  dplyr::filter(config == "baseline", category != "host piece") |>
  dplyr::group_by(identity_bin, integrity_bin) |>
  dplyr::summarise(baseline_rate = mean(recovered), .groups = "drop")

beta_per_rep <- beta_loci |>
  dplyr::filter(category != "host piece") |>
  dplyr::left_join(baseline_bin_rates, by = c("identity_bin", "integrity_bin")) |>
  dplyr::group_by(config, rep) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_loci = dplyr::n(),
                   mean_integrity = mean(integrity),
                   pct_integrity_lt_0.1 = 100 * mean(integrity < 0.1),
                   rate = mean(recovered),
                   predicted_rate = mean(baseline_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
                   pct_loci_without_baseline_bin = 100 * mean(is.na(baseline_rate)),
                   .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::group_by(rep) |>
  dplyr::mutate(diff_vs_baseline = rate - rate[config == "baseline"]) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

beta_summary <- beta_per_rep |>
  dplyr::group_by(config) |>
  dplyr::summarise(mean_integrity = mean(mean_integrity), pct_integrity_lt_0.1 = mean(pct_integrity_lt_0.1),
                   rate_mean = mean(rate), rate_sd = sd(rate),
                   diff_vs_baseline_mean = mean(diff_vs_baseline), diff_vs_baseline_sd = sd(diff_vs_baseline),
                   predicted_rate_mean = mean(predicted_rate),
                   pct_loci_without_baseline_bin = mean(pct_loci_without_baseline_bin), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(label = beta_labels[as.character(config)], .after = config)
kable(beta_summary, digits = 4,
      caption = paste0("Overall recovery (host pieces excluded) by beta distribution (mean +/- SD of 3 paired replicates), ",
                        "and recovery predicted from baseline per-bin rates re-weighted by each config's bin counts."))

write.csv(beta_per_rep, paste0(OUT, "beta_sweep_per_replicate.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(beta_summary, paste0(OUT, "beta_sweep_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

Saved file names: beta_sweep_per_replicate.csv, beta_sweep_summary.csv

Integrity distribution of each config (left) and recovery by integrity bin (right; pooled rate
within each replicate, mean +/- SD). If the per-bin recovery curves overlap, alpha/beta change
overall recovery only through the integrity distribution.

```{r, beta_sweep_plot, echo=FALSE, eval=sweep_done, fig.width = 10, fig.asp = 0.35}
plotwidth <- 10
plotheight <- 3.5
beta_colors <- c("beta(0.5, 2)" = "#D55E00", "beta(0.5, 0.7) default" = "grey40", "beta(2, 0.5)" = "#0072B2")
beta_plot_loci <- beta_loci |> dplyr::filter(category != "host piece") |>
  dplyr::mutate(label = factor(beta_labels[as.character(config)], levels = beta_labels[beta_levels]))

p_dist <- ggplot(beta_plot_loci, aes(x = integrity, colour = label)) +
  geom_density() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = beta_colors) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"), legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x = "Integrity", y = "Density", title = "Integrity distribution")

beta_integrity <- beta_plot_loci |>
  dplyr::group_by(label, rep, integrity_bin) |>
  dplyr::summarise(rate = mean(recovered), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::group_by(label, integrity_bin) |>
  dplyr::summarise(sd = sd(rate), rate = mean(rate), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(integrity_mid = integrity_bin / 10 + 0.05)

p_rate <- ggplot(beta_integrity, aes(x = integrity_mid, y = rate, colour = label)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 1.2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(rate - sd, 0), ymax = pmin(rate + sd, 1)), width = 0.02) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = beta_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black")) +
  labs(x = "Integrity (bin midpoint)", y = "Recovery rate", colour = NULL, title = "Recovery by integrity")

p_beta <- patchwork::wrap_plots(p_dist, p_rate, widths = c(1, 1.4))
p_beta
```

```{r, save_beta_sweep_plot, echo=FALSE, eval=sweep_done}
png(filename = paste0(OUT, "beta_sweep_integrity_recovery.png"), width = plotwidth, height = plotheight, units = "in", res = 1200)
print(p_beta)
while (!is.null(dev.list()))  dev.off()
```

Saved file name: beta_sweep_integrity_recovery.png

## 5. Notes

- The sweep is one-factor-at-a-time around scenario 1 with 3 paired replicates per setting; it
  shows the direction and size of each parameter's effect, not a full response surface.
- Recovery uses the same 80% reciprocal-overlap criterion as Fig. 5. Host pieces are evaluated
  as separate loci, so a host split by a nested insertion is counted as recovered only for the
  pieces RepeatMasker annotates with >= 80% reciprocal overlap.
